description: Full-stack architecture and development for Soberana: end-to-end web platform built with React (Vite) frontend and NestJS backend, optimized PostgreSQL schemas, containerized deployment on AWS ECS (backend), GCP hosting (frontend), domains via AWS Route 53, and automated CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions.

Backend development of Loopay FX: built from scratch a Foreign Exchange Market Intermediation (IMC) platform with Python (Django), PostgreSQL / AWS Aurora, optimized indices for complex queries, containerized on AWS ECS and managed via AWS Route 53.
Multi-tenant architecture design: scalable NestJS backend implementing Strategy and Adapter design patterns for decoupled integration of multiple external payment gateways.

AI-driven agile development: daily practical workflow using Spec-Driven Development (SDD) with Opencode and Engram to accelerate feature delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and enforce code modularity — drastically reducing token consumption costs.

DevOps, automation & security: modular Infrastructure as Code scripts with Terraform, continuous observability with OneUptime, AWS CloudTrail security audits, and CI/CD pipeline automation via GitHub Actions.
Senior technical leadership: resolving complex production bugs, refactoring legacy codebases with SOLID principles, and conducting thorough code reviews to ensure team-wide code quality.
Native hybrid mobile application development and deployment for iOS and Android using TypeScript (React Native).
Core backend services and APIs built with PHP (Laravel) and relational MySQL databases, optimizing query performance and table structure.
Real-time WebRTC intercom systems: deployed and administered CoTURN (STUN/TURN) servers in cloud environments for reliable peer-to-peer connectivity.
Persistent real-time messaging channels via WebSockets and integrated push notifications for low-latency mobile interaction.
Server infrastructure management with DigitalOcean Droplets, automating code delivery and testing via GitHub Actions pipelines.
Checkout BFF development: maintained transactional microservices under a Backend-for-Frontend architecture with Next.js and NestJS, integrating MongoDB for high-speed session data storage.

Financial risk systems (EDA): developed and optimized microservices within a distributed event-driven ecosystem on AWS, integrating decision engines with Taktile and operational UI panels with Retool.
Infrastructure as Code: provisioned and deployed highly redundant cloud resources via Terraform templates managed through the env0 automation platform.
Observability & product tracking: implemented telemetry with Datadog for infrastructure monitoring, user behavior analytics with Amplitude, and lead flow integrations via HubSpot API.
CI/CD automation: configured build, testing (unit and integration), and continuous deployment pipelines on GitHub Actions targeting AWS infrastructure.
Full-stack development and evolution of the main platform built on RedwoodJS: interactive React UI components, server-side Node.js logic, and optimized queries via GraphQL and Prisma ORM.
CI/CD setup and maintenance with GitHub Actions for automated deployment and integration workflows.
Microservices architecture design and development: Single Page Application (SPA) with Angular frontend and highly modular backend services using Express / Node.js with MongoDB.
Complex API integrations: implemented Algolia indexed search engine and embedded Zoom SDK video conferencing capabilities.
CI/CD automation: configured continuous integration and delivery pipelines using GitHub Actions.
